scripts.build: yarn workspace @m-control/core build && yarn workspace @m-control/mctl build
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces run lint && eslint test test-support tools templates scripts .claude/hooks vitest.config.ts --ext .ts,.js,.mjs
scripts.format: yarn workspaces run format && prettier --write "{test,test-support,scripts}/**/*.{ts,mjs}" "{tools,templates}/**/*.{ts,js}" vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json
